skills.description: This skill should be used after a complete PRD is produced, or when a product manager asks to extract PRD requirements and business rules into an Excel workbook for business-owner confirmation. It converts confirmed PRD content into a traceable review sheet, separates requirements from rules, highlights unresolved items and assumptions, and produces a Chinese .xlsx workbook that the requesting business side can review, fill in, and return.
skills.description_zh:
需求逻辑确认
目标
在完整 PRD 形成后，仅将业务方最需要核对的需求点、业务规则、待确认与冲突事项提炼为简洁的 Excel。输出必须以 PRD 为唯一事实来源，不擅自新增业务结论；所有未确认、假设、冲突和需要拍板的内容必须单独标识。

默认只生成 3 个工作表：

需求点确认
业务规则确认
待确认与冲突
不得默认生成“填写说明”“关键字段与口径”“流程状态权限确认”“验收点确认”等独立工作表。字段、权限、流程和验收内容只有在直接支撑需求点、业务规则或冲突说明时，才合并写入上述 3 个工作表。

触发场景
在以下请求中调用本技能：

“根据完整 PRD 生成业务方核对 Excel”
“把 PRD 需求点和规则点整理成确认表”
“生成需求逻辑确认表/业务确认清单”
“给提需求的一方核对 PRD”
“从 PRD 提炼需求、规则、字段、权限和验收点到 Excel”
默认在完整 PRD 产出后调用；若 PRD 仍处于草稿且存在未关闭的关键问题，仍可生成，但必须在工作簿中明确标注“待确认/不可直接进入研发”。
skills.name: UG-requirement-logic-confirmation

skills.description: This skill should be used when hardening long-running Python services against hangs, resource leaks, and process pile-ups — especially on Windows. Covers: reusing a global requests.Session() to kill repeated SSL handshake latency, replacing fire-and-forget subprocess.Popen with synchronous subprocess.run(timeout=) plus a re-entrancy lock, and bounding concurrent work with ThreadPoolExecutor + main-thread collection timeout + hard os._exit backstop. Trigger on phrases like "Python 服务卡死"、"子进程堆积"、"requests 太慢"、"Windows 下 HTTPS 慢"、"fire-and-forget 进程堆积"、"并发兜底"、"看门狗堆积"、"服务进不去". Distilled from a real postmortem where an unguarded Popen spawned 60+ zombie processes eating 3GB RAM and freezing the host.
skills.description_zh: 长期运行 Python 服务稳定性加固模板：全局复用 requests.Session 消除 Windows SSL 重复加载耗时；用 subprocess.run(timeout) + 锁文件替换 fire-and-forget Popen，防止子进程无限堆积；用 ThreadPoolExecutor + 主线程收集超时 + os._exit 硬兜底，避免批量 IO 卡死拖垮主机。附真实事故复盘与可运行脚本。
skills.name: Python 服务稳定性加固 · 防子进程堆积与并发兜底
